name: Lethargy of Tsathoggua
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [chaotic, evil, mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, cleric 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1d4 rounds
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target becomes wholly complacent, desiring nothing. The target stands idle or sits for the duration of the spell unless attacked. If the target is attacked, it is staggered for 1 round but can otherwise act normally.
